task: What is the name of the star system closest to the Solar System, and what are the discovered planets in it?
answer: The closest star system to the Solar System is Alpha Centauri, which includes Proxima Centauri at approximately 4.25 light-years away. The discovered planets in this system are: Proxima Centauri b (confirmed, Earth-sized, in the habitable zone, discovered 2016), Proxima Centauri c (candidate), and Proxima Centauri d (very light, confirmed). Alpha Centauri A may also have a gas giant candidate.
